name: Lake Cafe (Lake Side Resort Neermahal)
signature_dish: Tripuri-inspired thali with bamboo shoot curry
why_it_matters: The only proper resort restaurant on the Rudrasagar Lake side — the Lake Side Resort Neermahal (a Polo Hotels & Resorts property) markets it as the only sit-down dining within walking distance of the Neermahal palace jetty. Menu blends Indian, Pan-Asian and Tripuri-inspired dishes; the lake-facing setting is what you're paying for at lunch after the morning ferry.
insider_tip: Breakfast 7:30-10:30 AM, Lunch 12:30-3:00 PM, Dinner 7:30-10:30 PM. Inside Lake Side Resort Neermahal at Melaghar Main Road. Phone +91 99 8670 2889 to book ahead — the resort is the only nearby option, so weekend lunch fills up. The state-run Sagarmahal Tourist Lodge across the lake serves food too but reviews flag it as inconsistent (most recent Tripadvisor review 2019).
signature_address: Lake Side Resort Neermahal, Melaghar Main Road, Rudijala, Melaghar, Sepahijala District, Tripura 799115
